text: This solution, Fire and Emergency New Zealand (FENZ) Funding Model Reform addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Department of Internal Affairs (DIA), New Zealand Government/Cabinet, Fire and Emergency New Zealand (FENZ), Insurance Council of New Zealand (ICNZ), and Property sector stakeholders. The program was implemented in 2026 and focuses on regulation and collaboration.
